rows.question: Please generate a summary of the closing balances at the end of each month for each customer transactions, show the monthly changes and monthly cumulative bank account balances. Ensure that even if a customer has no account activity in a given month, the balance for that month is still included in the output.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH customer_monthly_net AS (
SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    m.month,
    COALESCE(a.monthly_net, 0) AS monthly_net
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id
    FROM customer_transactions
) c
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT strftime('%Y-%m', date(REPLACE(txn_date, '/', '-'))) AS month
    FROM customer_transactions
) m
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        strftime('%Y-%m', date(REPLACE(txn_date, '/', '-'))) AS month,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) AS monthly_net
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id, strftime('%Y-%m', date(REPLACE(txn_date, '/', '-')))
) a
    ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
   AND m.month = a.month
)
SELECT
    customer_id,
    month,
    SUM(monthly_net) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS closing_balance,
    monthly_net AS monthly_change,
    SUM(monthly_net) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_balance
FROM customer_monthly_net
ORDER BY customer_id, month

rows.question: Please help me identify the top 3 bowlers who, in the overs where the maximum runs were conceded in each match, gave up the highest number of runs in a single over across all matches. For each of these bowlers, provide the match in which they conceded these maximum runs. Only consider overs that had the most runs conceded within their respective matches, and among these, determine which bowlers conceded the most runs in a single over overall.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH over_runs_conceded AS (
SELECT
    b.match_id AS match,
    b.innings_no AS innings,
    b.over_id AS over,
    b.bowler AS bowler,
    SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) + COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0)) AS runs_conceded
FROM ball_by_ball AS b
LEFT JOIN batsman_scored AS bs
    ON b.match_id = bs.match_id
   AND b.over_id = bs.over_id
   AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
   AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
LEFT JOIN extra_runs AS er
    ON b.match_id = er.match_id
   AND b.over_id = er.over_id
   AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id
   AND b.innings_no = er.innings_no
GROUP BY b.match_id, b.innings_no, b.over_id, b.bowler
),
match_max_over_runs AS (
SELECT
    match,
    MAX(runs_conceded) AS max_runs
FROM over_runs_conceded
GROUP BY match
)
SELECT    o.bowler,
    o.runs_conceded,
    o.match
FROM over_runs_conceded AS o
JOIN match_max_over_runs AS m
    ON o.match = m.match
   AND o.runs_conceded = m.max_runs
ORDER BY o.runs_conceded DESC
LIMIT 3

rows.question: Could you generate a report that shows the number of delivered orders for each month in the years 2016, 2017, and 2018? Each column represents a year, and each row represents a month
rows.pred_sql:
WITH orders_normalized AS (
SELECT
    "order_id",
    date("order_purchase_timestamp") AS "order_date",
    "order_status"
FROM "olist_orders"
),
monthly_delivered_pivot AS (
SELECT
    CAST(strftime('%m', order_date) AS INTEGER) AS month,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', order_date) AS INTEGER) = 2016 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delivered_order_count_2016,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', order_date) AS INTEGER) = 2017 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delivered_order_count_2017,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', order_date) AS INTEGER) = 2018 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delivered_order_count_2018
FROM orders_normalized
WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY month
)
SELECT month, delivered_order_count_2016, delivered_order_count_2017, delivered_order_count_2018
FROM monthly_delivered_pivot
ORDER BY month ASC
